actions.reason: In BasicTokenizer.train and RegexTokenizer.train, the per-merge best-pair selection max(stats, key=stats.get) made one key-function call per distinct pair. It now takes max() over a list of the values (pure C), and finds the key with vals.index plus islice over the dict, since the first maximal value belongs to the first maximal key. The tie-break path (earliest first occurrence among tied pairs) is now a single C-level filter(cands.__contains__, ...) over the pair stream instead of Python loops; it gives the same pair. Outputs are byte-identical (equivalence harness passes) and train_ir drops 6.6%.
